en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Гајтан веѓи' (eyebrows like a braided cord) is my reading of a poetic image. 'Пуста' is rendered as 'wretched'.

lines.cyr: Саноќ ле Надо, саноќ не спијам,
lines.lat: Sanoḱ le Nado, sanoḱ ne spijam,
lines.en: All night, oh Nada, all night I do not sleep,

lines.cyr: пред порти стојам за да те видам.
lines.lat: pred porti stojam za da te vidam.
lines.en: I stand before the gate to see you.
My eyes shed tears, my heart grieves

lines.cyr: сè заради наш'та ле Надо пуста разделба.
lines.lat: sè zaradi naš'ta le Nado pusta razdelba.
lines.en: all because of our, oh Nada, wretched parting.
Come out, Nada, at least to the gate,

lines.cyr: за да ти видам белото лице,
lines.lat: za da ti vidam beloto lice,
lines.en: so that I can see your white face,
your white face, your black eyes

lines.cyr: и тие Надо мори гајтан веѓи.
lines.lat: i tie Nado mori gajtan veǵi.
lines.en: and those, Nada, hey, braid-thin eyebrows.

lines.cyr: Не можам Ѓорѓи, не можам либе,
lines.lat: Ne možam Ǵorǵi, ne možam libe,
lines.en: I cannot, Gjorgji, I cannot, love,

lines.cyr: не можам на порти да излезам,
lines.lat: ne možam na porti da izlezam,
lines.en: I cannot come out to the gate,
my mother, Gjorgji, has shut the gate,

lines.cyr: пенџер ми Ѓорѓи море татко соѕидал.
lines.lat: pendžer mi Ǵorǵi more tatko sodzidal.
lines.en: my father, Gjorgji, hey, has walled up the window.

lines.cyr: Татко ти Надо, та и мајка ти
lines.lat: Tatko ti Nado, ta i majka ti
lines.en: Your father, Nada, and your mother too,

lines.cyr: Бог ти ги убил, огин изгорел,
lines.lat: Bog ti gi ubil, ogin izgorel,
lines.en: may God kill them, may fire burn them,

lines.cyr: порти ќе турнам, пенџер ќе урнам
lines.lat: porti ḱe turnam, pendžer ḱe urnam
lines.en: I will knock down the gate, I will tear down the window

lines.cyr: и тебе Надо мори ќе земам.
lines.lat: i tebe Nado mori ḱe zemam.
lines.en: and you, Nada, hey, I will take.
